blocks.source: スターオーシャン3 DC
blocks.translation: Star Ocean 3 DC

blocks.source: 筆者は通常版を未プレイで、ディレクターズカット版のみをプレイ。通常版との違いは、バグ（特にフリーズ）が減り、バランス調整やキャラの追加が行われたこと。通常版はＰＳ２の型番によっては、フリーズで進行がままならないレベルとのことなので、少々値が高くても、こちらを買うべきかと思う。
blocks.translation: I had not played the original version and only played the Director's Cut. The differences from the original are fewer bugs (especially freezes), balance adjustments, and additional characters. Depending on the PS2 model number, the original apparently has so many freezes that progressing through the game can be nearly impossible, so I think you should buy this version even if it costs a little more.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 『星の海』と銘打っている割に、物語の大半が１つの星で展開されるのは相も変わらず。ただし、ＳＯ１、ＳＯ２ではちょっとしかなかった『宇宙船』などのＳＦ要素はずっと多く含まれている。また、用語解説が用意されており、一応のＳＦっぽさをかもし出している。
blocks.translation: Despite being branded as a “sea of stars,” it is still the case that most of the story takes place on a single planet. However, it contains far more science-fiction elements, such as “spaceships,” which appeared only briefly in SO1 and SO2. It also provides a glossary of terms, giving it at least a semblance of science fiction.

blocks.source: 前作までは、ひねりのなさすぎるお使いイベントがあったり、台詞回しに気になる箇所があったりと、正直に言えば、シナリオのレベルが低い点があったが、今作は合格点を上げられる程度に良くなった。グラフィックの向上とボイスの追加によっても、演出は大幅に向上している。
blocks.translation: The previous games had some low points in their scenarios, such as overly straightforward fetch quests and awkward dialogue. To be honest, however, this game has improved enough to earn a passing grade. The presentation has also improved dramatically thanks to the enhanced graphics and added voice acting.

blocks.source: ただし、終盤の展開には賛否両論あり。
blocks.translation: However, the developments toward the end have drawn mixed reactions.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: ３Ｄ空間を動き回るアクション戦闘が特徴。敵の攻撃を避けたり、プロテクト（防御）するといった要素が重要となっている。また、攻撃を連発していると『Guts』が減少するため、攻撃を止めて休む必要がある。等々、攻撃一辺倒だった前作よりも大きく進化している。
blocks.translation: Its defining feature is action combat in which you move around a 3D space. Elements such as dodging enemy attacks and using Protect (guarding) are important. In addition, repeatedly attacking reduces your “Guts,” so you need to stop attacking and rest. In many other ways, it is a major evolution over the previous game, which focused almost entirely on attacking.

blocks.source: 仲間キャラクターはそれぞれ個性があり、色々と動かしてみると楽しい。ただ、後半まで仲間にならないキャラクターが多いのが残念である。
blocks.translation: Each party member has a distinct personality, and it is fun to try controlling them in different ways. However, it is disappointing that many characters do not join your party until the latter half of the game.

blocks.source: 難易度は高めだが、ゲーム開始時に難易度調整が可能。ザコ戦、ボス戦共に、瞬殺するか、されるかの極端な戦闘が多い傾向にある。これは２もそうだったので、意図的にそういう調整にしているのかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is on the high side, but you can adjust it when starting the game. Both regular battles and boss battles tend to be extreme affairs where you either kill the enemy instantly or get killed instantly. Since the same was true of 2, perhaps the game was intentionally balanced that way.

blocks.source: ＤＣ版から追加された技のキャンセルによって、ひたすら同じ技を繰り返す単調な戦法が強すぎると感じた。また、敵から逃げながら遠距離攻撃を繰り返しているだけで、ほとんどの戦闘であっさり勝ててしまうのはどうかと。
blocks.translation: The technique-canceling feature added in the Director's Cut made me feel that the monotonous strategy of repeatedly using the same technique was far too powerful. I also question how easily you can win most battles simply by running away from enemies while repeatedly using ranged attacks.

blocks.source: 戦闘を繰り返していると、貰える経験値やお金にボーナスが付くシステムが存在しているのだが、敵の攻撃を受けると、ボーナスが消えることがあるため、なおさら遠距離からの戦いを助長している。
blocks.translation: There is a system that grants bonuses to the experience and money you receive when you fight battles repeatedly. However, taking an enemy attack can make the bonus disappear, which encourages fighting from a distance even more.

blocks.source: 戦闘で魔法を使う時に、いちいちメニューを開かねばならない。アクション戦闘において、これは流れが止まってしまうので好きではない。（僕の案だが、ＲまたはＬボタンを押しながら○×□△で、８通りまでの特技魔法が使えるってのはどうでしょ？）
blocks.translation: You have to open the menu every time you want to use magic in battle. In action combat, I dislike this because it brings the flow to a halt. (This is just my idea, but what about being able to use up to eight Techs or spells by holding the R or L button while pressing ○×□△?)

blocks.source: その代わり、魔法使用時に時間が止まって長い演出を見せ付けるといったことはなくなった。（前作は本当に酷かった・・・）今作は魔法使用時も動けるし、ほとんどの魔法は動いてかわせる。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, it no longer stops time to force you to watch a long presentation whenever magic is used. (The previous game was truly awful...) In this game, you can move while magic is being used, and you can dodge most spells by moving.

blocks.source: アイテムクリエイション（アイテム作成システム）は攻略情報が無いと難しい。かといって、攻略情報があると、作業になってしまうのだが・・・。
blocks.translation: Item Creation (the item crafting system) is difficult without a strategy guide. On the other hand, once you have a guide, it just becomes a chore...

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘前後のロードなどはほとんど気にならないレベル。ただ、扉を開ける時のアクションと切替時間については回数が多いこともあって、若干気になった。
blocks.translation: Loading before and after battles is hardly noticeable. However, the action of opening doors and the transition time were somewhat bothersome, partly because they occur so frequently.

blocks.source: 戦闘中のカメラワークについて、見えない範囲が多く、他の仲間や敵の状態を把握できないため、困る。特に手前側が見にくいため、筆者は操作キャラを手前側に移動させてしのいでいた。
blocks.translation: The battle camera is problematic because so much remains outside your view, making it difficult to keep track of the other party members and enemies. The area in front of you is especially difficult to see, so I got by by moving the character I was controlling toward the front.

blocks.source: このゲームの特徴として、特技にはＭＰを消費するものとＨＰを消費するものがあるのだが、技を連発すると、すぐにＨＰが減ってしまうため、毎戦闘ごとに回復が必要になるのが面倒だった。
blocks.translation: One feature of this game is that some Techs consume MP while others consume HP. However, using techniques repeatedly quickly depletes your HP, making it a hassle to heal after every battle.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 前作から大幅にグラフィックが強化。ＰＳ２では標準レベルといったところか。
blocks.translation: The graphics have been greatly enhanced from the previous game. For the PS2, they are about standard quality.

blocks.source: 一部、女性キャラの目が大き過ぎるのが気になる。目を大きくして可愛さを出すというのは良くある技法だが、やり過ぎて、顔のバランスが崩れている。特にヒロインのソフィアは一部で黒豆呼ばわりされる始末。マリアやネルはまともなバランスなのに・・・。
blocks.translation: Some of the female characters' eyes are distractingly large. Enlarging the eyes to make a character look cute is a common technique, but it has been overdone here, throwing off the balance of their faces. In particular, the heroine Sophia has even been called a “black bean” by some people. Maria and Nel have reasonably balanced features, though...

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 残念ながら、ゲームクリアまでこれといった曲に当たらなかった。音楽よりも、効果音やボイスの音量の方が優先されている場面が多いせいかもしれない。決して、質は低くないのだが・・・。
blocks.translation: Unfortunately, I did not encounter any particularly memorable tracks before completing the game. Perhaps this is because there are many scenes where the volume of the sound effects and voices is prioritized over the music. The quality is by no means low, though...

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: プレイする前に聞いていた評判では、『ストーリーはいまいちだが、戦闘が面白いゲーム』との意見が多く聞かれたが、実際にやってみると、ストーリーは前２作と比べると、ずっとしっかりしており、予想していたより面白かった。
blocks.translation: Before playing it, I had often heard people say that it was “a game with a mediocre story but enjoyable battles.” However, after actually playing it, I found the story much more solid than those of the previous two games, and more enjoyable than I had expected.

blocks.source: 特に、終盤の某展開に否定的な人が多いようだが、僕は事前にネタバレを知っていたせいか、そこまで悪い印象は持たなかった。
blocks.translation: Many people seem to be particularly negative about a certain development near the end, but perhaps because I already knew the spoiler beforehand, I did not come away with such a bad impression of it.

blocks.source: しかし、逆に戦闘は前作よりは、はるかに良いとはいえ絶賛する程とは思えなかった。（もっとも、戦闘の評価は難易度を上げてプレイするなどしてやりこめば、変わってくるのかもしれない。）
blocks.translation: Conversely, although the battles are far better than in the previous game, I did not think they were good enough to warrant unqualified praise. (That said, my opinion of the battles might change if I played more thoroughly, such as by raising the difficulty.)
